template.name: Social feed — Decipher
template.description: Native scrolling feed with likes and documented exposure states, assigned from a tab-delimited design file.
template.instructions: Use SocialFeed for each task of this 5-feed, 30-post design. Put tasks 1 through 5 once each, in order, in main. Each component includes its own suspend: one component per page. The base owns the single shared CSS/JS pair, .dat loader, original text/image resources, persistent assignment questions and automatic initialization step. Preserve all of these. Upload the bundled social-design.dat as a root/system file before compiling XML. Never replace it with browser randomization. Keep native Feed/task and Offer/task labels, fixed response codes 1/2/3, native Continue, zero-like validity and the exposure rule. Do not add branding, headers, footers, bylines, welcome pages, review pages, marketing copy or extra substantive questions. Keep the concise question/instructions and neutral Continue. Do not duplicate task numbers or place other visible questions on feed pages. The only input is task; other designs, counts, copy/image resources or schema changes require regeneration and native verification. Treat the provided design as a synthetic example, not a statistically optimized experiment.
